title: Hawking Radiation
description: Near a horizon the same happens without anyone accelerating: a black hole glows, at a temperature inversely proportional to its mass, and slowly evaporates. Unlocks the Micro Black Hole Evaporator.

puzzle.goal: A black hole of mass M glows as a black body. Write its temperature T, from ħ, c, gravity's constant G and Boltzmann's k.
puzzle.name: Hawking temperature of a mass
puzzle.ask: Find T in kelvin for M = @{M} kg (h = 1.0546e-34 for ħ, c = 2.998e8, G = 6.674e-11, k = 1.381e-23).
puzzle.method: The surface gravity of a Schwarzschild horizon is κ = c⁴/4GM; put it in kT = ħκ/2πc.
